cues.en: This is Choco Mountain.
cues.zh: 这是巧克力山。

cues.en: It's the third course in the flower cup in Nintendo's Mario Kart 64,
cues.zh: 它是任天堂《马力欧卡丁车64》花朵杯的第三条赛道。

cues.en: and honestly, it doesn't look too crazy at first glance.
cues.zh: 说实话，乍一看它并不算太离谱。

cues.en: It's just a brown course with a white sky. No crazy upside down or underwater driving like in the newer games.
cues.zh: 就是一条棕色赛道配白色天空。没有新作里那种疯狂倒转或水下驾驶。

cues.en: The walls are practically right on top of you, so you don't really have much room to navigate around the track.
cues.zh: 墙壁几乎就贴着你，所以你在赛道上根本没什么回旋余地。

cues.en: But you see, this course has a bit of a reputation.
cues.zh: 但你要知道，这条赛道可是有点名气的。

cues.en: There's a group of people who've been battling each other for the past couple of decades to finish the course in world record time.
cues.zh: 有一群人过去二十来年一直在互相较量，想以世界纪录时间完成这条赛道。

cues.en: What attracts these gamers to Chaco Mountain in particular?
cues.zh: 这些玩家为什么偏偏被 Chaco Mountain 吸引？

cues.en: Well, probably the fact that this course can be absolutely and completely broken.
cues.zh: 嗯，可能是因为这条赛道能被彻彻底底地攻破。

cues.en: Let's start by taking a close look at the track itself.
cues.zh: 我们先仔细看看这条赛道本身。

cues.en: Chaco Mountain begins with a few quick turns toward the top of the course, followed by a long 180 degree turn that puts you inside a tunnel.
cues.zh: Chaco Mountain 一开始是几个快速弯道，通向赛道顶部，接着是一个长长的 180 度弯，把你带进隧道。

cues.en: During each of these turns, it's optimal to do what's known as a mini turbo.
cues.zh: 在每个这样的弯道，最好做出所谓的迷你涡轮。

cues.en: You press r to hop and start your turn to go into a drift with white smoke coming out of the bottom of your cart.
cues.zh: 按 R 跳跃并开始转弯，进入漂移，车底会冒出白烟。

cues.en: You then push the control stick in the opposite direction that the turn is and push it back again.
cues.zh: 然后把摇杆推向转弯的反方向，再推回来。

cues.en: The smoke should turn yellow.
cues.zh: 烟雾应该会变成黄色。

cues.en: Do the same thing with the control stick again and the smoke turns orange.
cues.zh: 再次用摇杆重复同样的操作，烟雾就会变成橙色。

cues.en: That means your mini turbo is complete and when you let go of r, you'll get a slight speed boost.
cues.zh: 这意味着你的迷你涡轮完成了，松开 R 后，你会获得一点速度提升。

cues.en: It sounds like this will be a slow process, but a skilled player can execute dozens of these mini turbos in a row around the course.
cues.zh: 听起来这过程好像很慢，但熟练的玩家能在赛道上连续做出几十次这样的迷你涡轮加速。

cues.en: The entire start of Choco Mountain is fittingly a loop around a chocolate mountain as you could see from this overhead view.
cues.zh: 从俯视图可以看到，Choco Mountain 的起点整段恰好就是绕着巧克力山跑一圈。

cues.en: After going through the tunnel, you drive along a winding section with hills on both sides of you. Then you make another 180 degree turn around a pool of water with boulders falling from above.
cues.zh: 穿过隧道后，你会行驶在一段两侧都是山丘的蜿蜒路段上。接着你绕着水池再做一次 180 度转弯，头顶还有巨石不断落下。

cues.en: Then another right turn, a few more bouncing hills, and you're finished with the lap.
cues.zh: 然后又一个右转弯，再翻过几个起伏的坡，这一圈就结束了。

cues.en: Alright. Doesn't seem so crazy. Right? That's probably what most people were thinking when this game was released in North America in February
cues.zh: 好吧，看起来也没那么疯狂，对吧？这大概就是这款游戏1997年2月在北美发售时大多数人的想法

cues.en: But it didn't take too long before people figured out that there was a lot more to this track than met the eye.
cues.zh: 但没过多久，人们就发现这条赛道远不止表面看起来那么简单。

cues.en: And it all started with a shortcut that was discovered literally right after the game came out.
cues.zh: 而这一切都始于一个捷径，它几乎在游戏刚发售时就被发现了。

cues.en: Although several players probably discovered the shortcut independently of one another, it was first documented in an email from legendary Mario Kart 64 player David Wan from 04/19/1997.
cues.zh: 虽然可能有多名玩家各自独立发现了这个捷径，但最早记录它的是传奇 Mario Kart 64 玩家 David Wan 于 1997 年 4 月 19 日发出的一封邮件。

cues.en: The email provided the following instructions for performing the shortcut.
cues.zh: 邮件中给出了完成该捷径的以下说明。

cues.en: Drive through Chaco Mountain as normal until you come to the part where you can see the overpass on your left. In the time trial mode, you could see a guardrail to your left. Go to the part just before it starts going downhill and then turn 90 degrees to your left.
cues.zh: 照常驶过 Chaco Mountain，直到来到左侧能看到高架桥的路段。在计时赛模式下，你能看到左侧有一道护栏。走到刚开始下坡之前的位置，然后向左转 90 度。

cues.en: Drive into the wall and press the r button to jump in about the moment you hit it, and you will jump right over the wall.
cues.zh: 开车撞向墙，差不多在撞上的瞬间按 R 键跳起，你就能直接跳过这堵墙。

cues.en: This little technique became known as a wall jump.
cues.zh: 这个小技巧后来被称为墙跳。

cues.en: Practically anywhere in the game, if you drive into a wall and press r to hop the instant before you hit the wall, you will jump off of the wall and go much much higher.
cues.zh: 游戏里几乎任何地方，只要开车撞向墙，并在撞墙前的一瞬间按 R 键跳起，你就会从墙上借力跳起，而且跳得高得多。

cues.en: Mario Kart 64 runs at about 30 frames per second on the NTSC version.
cues.zh: Mario Kart 64 的 NTSC 版大约以每秒 30 帧运行。

cues.en: So in most situations, you only have a thirtieth of a second to time a wall jump.
cues.zh: 大多数情况下，你只有三十分之一秒的时间来把握墙跳的时机。

cues.en: But, since your kart is traveling so fast, sometimes it's not possible at all to time the wall jump.
cues.zh: 但你的卡丁车速度太快，有时候根本来不及把握墙跳时机。

cues.en: The window you have the jump is actually smaller than the length that your kart travels in a frame if you're going top speed.
cues.zh: 如果你处于最高速，可用来起跳的窗口其实比卡丁车在一帧内行驶的距离还短。

cues.en: So, sometimes your kart skips over that perfect position and hits the wall before you have a chance to jump.
cues.zh: 所以有时候卡丁车会直接越过那个完美位置，在你来得及起跳之前就撞上墙。

cues.en: This is known as the zero frame jump, and when it happens, your cart tumbles like this.
cues.zh: 这被称为零帧跳；发生这种情况时，你的卡丁车会像这样翻滚。

cues.en: Looking at the overhead view of Chaco Mountain, it's easy to see why this saves so much time. The shortcut is performed here, and you're jumping from the lower portion to the upper portion.
cues.zh: 看 Chaco Mountain 的俯视图，很容易明白这为什么能省这么多时间。捷径就是在这里完成的，你从下段跳到上段。

cues.en: When the designers made this course, they put both ends of the loop around the water right next to each other.
cues.zh: 设计师设计这条赛道时，把绕水域的环道两端放得紧挨在一起。

cues.en: The idea was to put a guardrail on the upper portion so you wouldn't fall off onto the lower portion and put a wall next to the lower portion so you couldn't get up to the top. But with the wall joint being discovered, that pretty much eliminated the wall barrier.
cues.zh: 原本的想法是在上段装护栏，防止你掉到下段；并在下段旁边筑墙，让你上不去顶部。但墙体接缝被发现后，那道墙屏障基本就失效了。

cues.en: So as long as players were able to press the r button at the right time and didn't get zero framed, they would be able to skip the long loop around the water with boulders falling and save a few seconds.
cues.zh: 只要玩家能在正确时机按下 R 键，并且没被零帧判定坑到，就能跳过那段绕着水域、有巨石掉落的长路线，省下几秒。

cues.en: In that same email, David Wong provided the first two shortcut world record times for Chaco Mountain.
cues.zh: 在同一封邮件里，David Wong 给出了 Chaco Mountain 前两个捷径的世界纪录时间。

cues.en: Twenty nine eighty six for the fastest single lap and one thirty two fifty three for the fastest three laps.
Unfortunately,
cues.zh: 不幸的是，

cues.en: no video exists for either of these times, and I couldn't find a picture of them anywhere either.
cues.zh: 这两个成绩都没有视频记录，我也到处找不到它们的截图。

cues.en: Still, the times were particularly important because they set the groundwork for the two ways Chalker Mountain could be played.
cues.zh: 不过，这些成绩特别重要，因为它们为 Chalker Mountain 的两种玩法奠定了基础。

cues.en: Either non shortcut, where you drive around like normal, or shortcut, where you do the wall jump.
cues.zh: 要么是不走捷径，像平常一样开车绕行；要么是走捷径，做蹬墙跳。

cues.en: And over the next couple of months in 1997,
cues.zh: 而在1997年接下来的几个月里，

cues.en: there were reports that players lowered the shortcut times by realizing that you didn't need to actually stop to do the wall jump, it could instead just drift into the wall like this.
cues.zh: 有报告称，玩家发现做蹬墙跳其实不必真的停下来，而是可以像这样直接滑进墙里，从而缩短了捷径用时。

cues.en: A guy named Kevin Booth reportedly lowered the three lap world record down to a one twenty eight and someone with the nickname ABE apparently took it down to one twenty two.
cues.zh: 据说有个叫 Kevin Booth 的人把三圈世界纪录刷到了 1 分 28 秒，而一个绰号 ABE 的人显然又把它刷到了 1 分 22 秒。

cues.en: And then came 06/24/1997.
cues.zh: 然后就到了 1997 年 6 月 24 日。

cues.en: David Waugh would send out another email on this day, and he was about to reveal to the world more about Chaco Mountain.
cues.zh: 这一天，David Waugh 又发了一封邮件，他即将向世界揭示更多关于 Chaco Mountain 的信息。

cues.en: If you thought the wall jump was crazy, get ready. David Wan's about to completely destroy Chaco Mountain.
cues.zh: 如果你觉得蹬墙跳已经很疯狂了，那就做好准备——David Wan 要彻底摧毁 Chaco Mountain 了。

cues.en: Juan had already discovered one shortcut on Chaco Mountain, the Great Wall Jump.
cues.zh: Juan 已经在 Chaco Mountain 上发现了一条捷径：Great Wall Jump。

cues.en: But this email had three more, and the kicker,
cues.zh: 但这封邮件里还有三条，而且最关键的是，

cues.en: all three were discovered within the same twenty four hour period.
cues.zh: 这三条都是在同一个 24 小时内被发现的。

cues.en: Shortcut number one. After completing seven sixteenths of a lap, go immediately to the left and jump scale the mountain.
cues.zh: 第一条捷径。跑完 7/16 圈后，立刻向左，跳跃并攀上山体。

cues.en: Rapidly jump with the r button while driving into the mountain.
cues.zh: 一边朝山体开，一边快速按 R 键跳跃。

cues.en: If you do this in the right place, you'll completely clear the mountain your kart will flip for a few seconds and land just behind three hills immediately behind the finish line.
cues.zh: 如果在正确的位置这么做，你会完全越过山体，卡丁车会翻转几秒，然后落在终点线正后方三座小山的后面。

cues.en: Let's see what's actually happening here. The player's goal is to get from about this spot to about this spot.
cues.zh: 我们来看看这里实际发生了什么。玩家的目标是从大概这个位置到达大概这个位置。

cues.en: Normally, if you try to hop up the side of hill or mountain on the track, you'll just tumble down when you get to the top.
cues.zh: 通常，如果你试着沿赛道爬上斜坡或山的一侧，爬到顶时就会直接滚落下来。

cues.en: But, as you can see in this 2008 video from Matthias Rustemeyer,
cues.zh: 但正如 Matthias Rustemeyer 在 2008 年的这段视频中所展示的，

cues.en: there's one polygon here at the top that you can just barely jump onto.
cues.zh: 顶部这里有一个多边形，你勉强能跳上去。

cues.en: If you do, it'll cause you to tumble down the other way, skipping you across the whole loop.
cues.zh: 如果你跳上去，它会让你朝另一侧滚落，从而让你一路跳过整个赛道环。

cues.en: Shortcut number two.
cues.zh: 第二条捷径。

cues.en: Just before you reach the big hill prior to the overpass area, go directly into the wall on your left.
cues.zh: 就在你到达立交桥区域前的那座大山之前，直接冲向左侧的墙。

cues.en: Drive into it at full speed and jump as you hit it. If you do this in the right place, you will clear the wall and land in the same area as in the first shortcut.
cues.zh: 全速撞上去，并在撞到的瞬间跳起。如果在正确的位置操作，你就能翻过墙，落到与第一条捷径相同的区域。

cues.en: This shortcut was more or less a faster version of the jump scaling shortcut.
cues.zh: 这条捷径大致上是跳跃缩放捷径的更快版本。

cues.en: You end up cutting out a little less of the track. But the time you save from not having to jump your way up and down the wall more than makes up for it.
cues.zh: 你最终切掉的赛道会少一点。但不用沿着墙跳上跳下所节省的时间，完全足以弥补这一点。

cues.en: Shortcut number three.
cues.zh: 第三条捷径。

cues.en: At the very beginning of the course, just drive around one cart length forward from the start line and drive into the wall on your left with the aid of a mushroom.
cues.zh: 在赛道最开始，从起跑线往前开大约一个车身长度，借助蘑菇撞向你左侧的墙。

cues.en: Jump with the r button as you hit it, and you might land on top of the mountain.
cues.zh: 撞上的同时按 R 键跳跃，你可能就会落到山顶上。

cues.en: If you do it properly, Lakitie will pick you up and place you right at the tunnel.
cues.zh: 如果操作得当，Lakitie 会接住你，直接把你放到隧道那里。

cues.en: This one might look the most crazy of all of them, but in reality,
cues.zh: 这条看起来可能是所有捷径里最疯狂的，但实际上，

cues.en: all that was happening was you got boosted up to right around the point where the track overlaps itself.
cues.zh: 发生的只是你被加速送到了赛道自我重叠处附近的位置。

cues.en: The game thinks you're right next to the tunnel, so it puts you inside of it when you get set back down.
cues.zh: 游戏以为你就在隧道旁边，所以当你被放回赛道时，会把你放进隧道里。

cues.en: Unfortunately,
cues.zh: 不幸的是，

cues.en: Juan also mentioned that he didn't believe the jerk was possible to do in the time trials mode, since he'd only gotten it to work in the Grand Prix 150 cc mode.
cues.zh: Juan 还提到，他不认为 jerk 能在计时赛模式里做出来，因为他只在 150cc 大奖赛模式中成功过。

cues.en: Your top speed is slightly faster in one fifty cc than in time trials, and since you needed to jump up so high, the more speed you had, the better.
cues.zh: 你在 150cc 里的最高速度比计时赛稍快；而且既然你需要跳那么高，速度越快越好。

cues.en: Well, now the floodgates were open. World records were available to any skilled player who wanted to get them. David Juan was once again the first to do so, providing times of twenty three eighty one for the fastest single lap, and one fourteen fifty two for the fastest three laps of Chaco Mountain.
cues.zh: 现在闸门已经打开，任何有实力的玩家都有机会拿下世界纪录。David Juan 又一次成为第一个做到的人，他跑出了单圈最快 23 秒 81，以及 Chaco Mountain 三圈最快 1 分 14 秒 52。

cues.en: The jump scaling shortcut ended up being pretty useless for his purposes,
cues.zh: 结果这个跳跃缩放的捷径对他来说没什么用，

cues.en: since it was slower and more difficult than the hill jump. The huge wall jump shortcut at the start didn't help him much either, since world records were done in time trials instead of one fifty cc.
cues.zh: 因为它比山坡跳更慢也更难。起点那个巨大的撞墙跳捷径对他帮助也不大，因为世界纪录是在计时赛里跑的，而不是 150cc。

cues.en: But this hill jump was huge. It saved about five seconds per lap over the gray wall jump, and it wasn't incredibly difficult.
cues.zh: 但这个山丘跳意义重大。相比灰墙跳，它每圈大约省下五秒，而且难度并不算特别高。

cues.en: Just time the jump correctly and hope you didn't get zero framed.
cues.zh: 只要卡准起跳时机，然后祈祷别被零帧坑掉就行。

cues.en: That's where the five second time save came from over Juan's old single lap record and how he was able to cut off so much time over the three lap world record.
cues.zh: 这就是相对 Juan 旧单圈纪录省下五秒的来源，也是他能在三圈世界纪录上砍掉这么多时间的原因。

cues.en: His strategy was to do a hill jump and drive as well as he could for the fastest single lap and do a hill jump once each lap for the three lap record.
cues.zh: 他的策略是：做山丘跳，并尽可能把车开到最好，以拿下最快单圈；至于三圈纪录，则是每圈都做一次山丘跳。

cues.en: As time went on, more skilled players came along to take the record lower.
cues.zh: 随着时间推移，越来越多技术娴熟的玩家出现，把纪录刷新得更低。

cues.en: But you must keep in mind that the mentality of speedrunning was different back in the late nineties.
cues.zh: 但你要记住，在九十年代末，速通的心态和现在不一样。

cues.en: It operated more off of a system of trust and respect.
cues.zh: 那时更多是靠一套信任与尊重的体系来运作。

cues.en: If you were a respected runner who could prove your skills through live appearances or some videotapes,
cues.zh: 如果你是一位受人尊敬的跑者，能通过现场露面或一些录像带证明自己的实力，

cues.en: most reasonable times you submitted will be accepted even without much evidence.
cues.zh: 那么你提交的大部分合理成绩，即使没有太多证据也会被接受。

cues.en: A lot of world record runs didn't have video proof and weren't well documented other than old websites and Yahoo groups posts.
cues.zh: 很多世界纪录成绩没有视频证据，除了旧网站和 Yahoo 群组帖子之外，记录也很不完整。

cues.en: So it's nearly impossible to decipher exactly who got world records when in Mario Kart '60 four from back in the late nineties.
cues.zh: 所以，几乎不可能准确弄清上世纪九十年代末《Mario Kart 64》里谁在什么时候拿到过世界纪录。

cues.en: From what I could gather, the world records for Choco Mountain traded hands a few times late nineteen ninety seven and early nineteen ninety eight.
cues.zh: 据我所能收集到的信息，Choco Mountain 的世界纪录在 1997 年末和 1998 年初几次易手。

cues.en: Jason Walls, Kevin Booth, Jonathan Bernier,
cues.zh: Jason Walls、Kevin Booth、Jonathan Bernier，

cues.en: and possibly a few other people all took turns lowering the Chaco Mountain shortcut records in '97 and '98.
cues.zh: 以及可能还有另外几个人，他们在 97 年和 98 年轮流刷新了 Chaco Mountain 捷径纪录。

cues.en: But a guy named Alex Penev would end up changing the playing field. Up until this point, nobody had held any Chaco Mountain shortcut record for longer than a few months.
cues.zh: 但一个叫 Alex Penev 的人最终改变了格局。在此之前，还没有人能把任何 Chaco Mountain 捷径纪录保持超过几个月。

cues.en: Penev would end up holding the three lap Chaco Mountain shortcut record for a total of four years and ten months.
cues.zh: Penev 最终把三圈 Chaco Mountain 捷径纪录保持了总共四年十个月。

cues.en: He would end up holding the one lap record for a total of more than six years.
cues.zh: 他最终保持这项单圈纪录总计超过六年。

cues.en: Penev is well known for having speedran dozens of games at very high levels.
cues.zh: Penev 以极高水准速通过数十款游戏而闻名。

cues.en: Nearly every Mario Kart game, other Mario games, and Zelda just to name a few. His first Chalka Mountain record achieved was the one lap record on 09/30/1998.
cues.zh: 几乎每一款 Mario Kart、其他 Mario 游戏，以及 Zelda，仅举几例。他在 Chalka Mountain 的首个纪录，是 1998 年 9 月 30 日的单圈纪录。

cues.en: He would proceed to lower this record 12 times.
cues.zh: 随后他又将这项纪录刷新了 12 次。

cues.en: The only time he didn't have this record from then until December 2005 was a one year span from August 2001 through August 2002 when Miller had the record.
cues.zh: 从那时到 2005 年 12 月，他唯一没有这项纪录的时期，是 2001 年 8 月到 2002 年 8 月这一年，当时 Miller 持有该纪录。

cues.en: Penn have also realized that the tunnel warp at the start was possible to do in time trials if you drift into the wall like this. It saved around two seconds and using it, he lowered the one lap time down to sub twenty seconds.
cues.zh: Penn 还发现，起步处的隧道穿墙在计时赛里也能做到，只要像这样漂移撞墙。这个技巧节省了约两秒，利用它，他把单圈时间降到了20秒以内。

cues.en: His reign over the three lap record was similar. He first got it in October 1998 and lowered it seven times. The only time he didn't have this record from then until December 2005 was a two year span from May 2000 to August 2002 when Simmons had the world record.
cues.zh: 他对三圈纪录的统治也类似。他于1998年10月首次拿到该纪录，并七次刷新。从那时到2005年12月，他唯一没有这项纪录的时期，是2000年5月到2002年8月这两年，当时世界纪录由 Simmons 保持。

cues.en: Now, there's one very important distinction about Alex Penev that I have to make. He played on the PAL version of the game.
cues.zh: 现在，关于 Alex Penev，我必须做一个非常重要的区分。他玩的是游戏的 PAL 版本。

cues.en: The NTSC version of Mario Kart 64 runs at about 30 frames per second, while the PAL version of the game runs at 25 frames per second. This meant that the PAL version only ran at five sixth the speed of the NTSC version.
cues.zh: Mario Kart 64 的 NTSC 版本大约以每秒 30 帧运行，而游戏的 PAL 版本以每秒 25 帧运行。这意味着 PAL 版本的速度只有 NTSC 版本的六分之五。

cues.en: So not only would the game be played in slightly slower motion on PAL, but all times would be about 17% slower too.
cues.zh: 所以，PAL 版本不仅游戏画面会稍微慢一点，所有计时成绩也都会慢大约 17%。

cues.en: In order to compensate for this, the Mario Kart 64 community created the combined rank system, which could accurately compare times from each version of the game. A thirty second lap on PAL, for example, would be equivalent to a twenty five second lap on NTSC.
cues.zh: 为了弥补这一差异，马力欧卡丁车64社区创建了合并排名系统，能准确比较各个版本的成绩。比如 PAL 版的一圈三十秒，相当于 NTSC 版的二十五秒。

cues.en: For simplicity's sake, I'm just gonna be referring to most PAL times as their NTSC equivalent.
cues.zh: 为简单起见，我后面提到的大部分 PAL 成绩，都会直接说成对应的 NTSC 成绩。

cues.en: Anyway, Penne was able to take the fastest lap time down about half a second to twenty one point five eight seconds by just driving better, and then to about nineteen and a half seconds by using the tunnel jump.
cues.zh: 总之，Penne 仅靠开得更好，就把最快单圈成绩缩短了约半秒，降到二十一点五八秒；之后又借助隧道跳，把成绩压到大约十九点五秒。

cues.en: He was cutting corners tighter, having cleaner mini turbos,
cues.zh: 他过弯切得更贴，迷你涡轮也更干净，而且每次都会做一次山坡跳跃。

cues.en: all while doing a hill jump every time. He would take the three lap time down to one zero seven thirty two by 2,002 by doing the same thing.
cues.zh: 到2002年，他靠同样的做法把三圈时间降到1:07.32。

cues.en: In the first few months of Mario Kart 60 four's release, four shortcuts were found on Chaco Mountain.
cues.zh: 《Mario Kart 64》发售后的头几个月，Choco Mountain 上发现了四个捷径。

cues.en: Over the next several years, zero new shortcuts were found. Instead, a few were theorized.
cues.zh: 接下来几年，没有发现新捷径。相反，有几条只停留在理论推测中。

cues.en: In the early two thousands, Miller theorized a trick where you would bounce off of the wall in the tunnel and trigger the next lap to start.
cues.zh: 2000年代初，Miller 提出了一种技巧理论：在隧道里从墙上弹开，并触发下一圈开始。

cues.en: Although he got some very strange bounces from the walls, he was never able to get his trick to work.
cues.zh: 尽管他从墙上弹出了些非常奇怪的反弹，但他始终没能让这个技巧成功。

cues.en: Greg I from the Mario Kart forums also theorized the trick. It was very similar to the existing wall jump at the start of the track, only instead of getting picked up by Lakitu,
cues.zh: Mario Kart 论坛的 Greg I 也推测出了这个技巧。它和赛道起点处现有的蹬墙跳非常相似，只不过不是被 Lakitu 捞起来，

cues.en: you would hold left as you jumped and completely clear over the wall and land on the track below.
cues.zh: 而是在起跳时按住左方向键，完全越过墙，落到下方的赛道上。

cues.en: Once again, however, while this trick was attempted,
cues.zh: 然而，和之前一样，尽管有人尝试了这个技巧，

cues.en: nobody was able to get it to work.
cues.zh: 却没有人能成功。

cues.en: Yes, Chaco Mountain was still an unsolved puzzle.
cues.zh: 是的，Chaco Mountain 仍然是个未解之谜。

cues.en: Although some pieces of it were put together, it was clear there still a lot more to the track that hadn't yet been found. But while they searched for more shortcuts, they figured they might as well get some more world records as well.
cues.zh: 虽然已经拼出了其中一些部分，但显然这条赛道还有更多东西尚未被发现。不过，在寻找更多捷径的同时，他们觉得不妨顺手再拿几个世界纪录。

cues.en: Over on the one lap side, shadow of miles was able to get a seventeen sixty eight lap in 2,005,
cues.zh: 在单圈方面，shadow of miles 在 2005 年跑出了 1:17.68 的单圈，

cues.en: which was more than a second and a half faster than Pennev's best time.
cues.zh: 这比 Pennev 的最好成绩快了超过一秒半。

cues.en: It was the same route of doing a tunnel jump at the start and then doing a hill jump, but his hill jump was so clean that he landed safely on the track without needing to tumble down the other side.
cues.zh: 它还是同一条路线：开局先做一次隧道跳，然后再做一次山丘跳，但他的山丘跳干净利落，安全落在赛道上，不用从另一侧翻滚下去。

cues.en: This lap would end up standing for over four years.
cues.zh: 这个单圈纪录最终保持了四年多。

cues.en: For the three lap record, Carlo and Miles took turns lowering it with the help of a tunnel jump and three hill jumps.
cues.zh: 为了三圈纪录，Carlo 和 Miles 轮流借助一次隧道跳和三次山丘跳把它压低。

cues.en: Recorded runs were much more common at this point, but as you could see from Carlo's video tapes, they weren't always at the highest quality.
cues.zh: 到这时，录制跑法已经很常见，但从 Carlo 的录像带可以看出，画质并不总是很高。

cues.en: A camcorder recording of a VHS tape was sometimes the best we have.
cues.zh: 用摄像机翻拍的VHS录像带，有时已经是我们能拿到的最好资料。

cues.en: Well, now we're moving on to the year 2007,
cues.zh: 好，现在我们来到2007年，

cues.en: and it's time to introduce you to one of my favorite speedrunners of all time.
cues.zh: 该给你介绍我最喜欢的速通玩家之一了。

cues.en: You may not have heard of him before, but you're definitely not gonna forget him now. This is v a j.
cues.zh: 你可能以前没听说过他，但现在你绝对不会忘记他。这就是 VAJ。

cues.en: VHA began getting Mario Kart 64 world records in the mid two thousands. And by 2007,
cues.zh: VAJ 在2000年代中期开始拿下《马力欧卡丁车64》的世界纪录。到2007年，

cues.en: he was working on Choco Mountain.
cues.zh: 他正在攻克 Choco Mountain 这条赛道。

cues.en: On May eighth of that year, he got a new world record,
cues.zh: 那年5月8日，他创下了新的世界纪录，

cues.en: a one twelve fifty on PAL, equivalent to a one minute flat time for NTSC,
cues.zh: 在PAL制式下跑出1分12秒50，相当于NTSC制式下的1分整，

cues.en: done by executing three hill jumps and two tunnel jumps.
cues.zh: 靠完成三次山坡跳和两次隧道跳做到的。

cues.en: Like most, he submitted this time to the Choco Mountain leaderboards on mariokart64.com,
cues.zh: 像大多数人一样，他把这个成绩提交到了mariokart64.com的Choco Mountain排行榜，

cues.en: but he was too hyped to do that right away.
cues.zh: 但他太激动了，没能马上这么做。

cues.en: Instead, he turned on his camcorder and filmed his reaction to the time first.
cues.zh: 相反，他先打开摄像机，拍下了自己对这一成绩的反应。

cues.en: This is what I'm talking about, Mucacha.
cues.zh: 这才像话嘛，Mucacha。

cues.en: World record.
cues.zh: 世界纪录。

cues.en: Let's do it again.
cues.zh: 我们再来一次。

cues.en: Check it out.
cues.zh: 看看这个。

cues.en: V
cues.zh: V

cues.en: As much of a character as V a j is, he's also an incredibly good Mario Kart 64 player.
cues.zh: Vaj 虽然是个很有个性的人，但他也是《马力欧卡丁车 64》极其厉害的玩家。

cues.en: One of the best ever to play the game, in fact.
cues.zh: 事实上，他是这款游戏史上最强的玩家之一。

cues.en: This three lap time of his stood for nearly seven years.
cues.zh: 他这个三圈成绩保持了将近七年。

cues.en: And in the meantime, he was busting out world record after world record on nearly every other track in the game.
cues.zh: 而在此期间，他在游戏里几乎其他每一条赛道上都接连刷新世界纪录。

cues.en: One of those world records was for Choco Mountain one lap.
cues.zh: 其中一项世界纪录是 Choco Mountain 的单圈成绩。

cues.en: He lowered Miles four and a half year old world record in 2010
cues.zh: 2010年，他刷新了 Miles 保持了四年半的世界纪录

cues.en: before being beaten by Carlo and then he eventually took it down to a seventeen fifty nine or twenty one fifteen on Powell in 2013.
cues.zh: 后来他被 Carlo 击败，最终在2013年于 Powell 赛道上把成绩降到 17:59 或 21:15。

cues.en: He didn't record a reaction video this time unfortunately,
cues.zh: 可惜这次他没录反应视频，

cues.en: but he did provide a video of the run itself.
cues.zh: 但他提供了这次跑动本身的视频。

cues.en: No new strategies were used. It was all just the tunnel jump and the hill jump once again.
cues.zh: 没有采用新策略，还是隧道跳和山丘跳。

cues.en: But you can see how tightly he was cutting all of his turns. He was trying to leave no margin of error for anybody to beat his time.
cues.zh: 但你能看出他每个弯都切得很紧，想不给任何人留打破他成绩的余地。

cues.en: So now we're in 2014.
cues.zh: 现在时间来到2014年。

cues.en: V a j is in control of both Chaco Mountain shortcut records and for the past decade, the discovery of new strategies has been pretty dormant.
cues.zh: V a j 同时保持着 Chaco Mountain 两条捷径的纪录，而在过去十年里，新策略的发现基本处于停滞状态。

cues.en: But remember back in 2005,
cues.zh: 但回想2005年，

cues.en: Greg posted about a theoretical shortcut you would jump completely over the wall at the start and land on the track below.
cues.zh: Greg 发帖提到过一条理论上的捷径：在起点直接跳过整堵墙，落到下方的赛道上。

cues.en: For nine years, it seemed to be no more than the theory.
cues.zh: 九年来，它似乎一直都只是个理论。

cues.en: And then in February 2014,
cues.zh: 然后到了2014年2月，

cues.en: Greg posted this in the Mario Kart forums.
cues.zh: Greg 在 Mario Kart 论坛上发了这个。

cues.en: Greg called out the possibility of this trick and nine years later, he was the one to do it for the first time.
cues.zh: Greg 曾提出过这个技巧的可能性，九年后，他成了第一个把它做出来的人。

cues.en: He hit the wall in the perfect spot, held left, and was able to completely clear the wall to land on the track below.
cues.zh: 他在完美的位置撞上墙，按住左方向，成功完全越过墙，落到下方的赛道上。

cues.en: As you can see, this trick would skip the whole loop at the start just like the old tunnel jump did, but instead of having Lakitu pick you up while the timer keeps ticking, you simply land and keep driving.
cues.zh: 如你所见，这个技巧会像以前的隧道跳跃一样跳过开头整个环道，但不用在计时器继续走动时被 Lakitu 捞起来，你只需落地继续开就行。

cues.en: The key to this trick was the setup.
cues.zh: 这个技巧的关键在于前置设置。

cues.en: Instead of drifting into the wall and using a mushroom, you had to perform what's known as a snack boost.
cues.zh: 你不能直接漂移撞墙再用蘑菇，而要做一个所谓的 snack boost。

cues.en: If you're holding b and use a mushroom while touching a wall, the wall initially holds you back and drastically increases your speed.
cues.zh: 如果你按住 B 键，并在贴墙时使用蘑菇，墙一开始会挡住你，同时大幅提升你的速度。

cues.en: When you release from the wall, you'll fly forward at a really high speed.
cues.zh: 当你离开墙时，会以非常高的速度向前飞出。

cues.en: So highest speed that when you jump off of the wall, you'll be able to completely clear it and skip getting picked up by Lakitu.
cues.zh: 速度高到当你从墙上跳开时，能完全越过它，并跳过被 Lakitu 抓走。

cues.en: This trick would be known as the Greg style named after its creator. Creator.
cues.zh: 这个技巧后来被称为 Greg 式，以它的创造者命名。创造者。

cues.en: It saved around two seconds over the old tunnel jump and throughout February 2014,
cues.zh: 相比旧的隧道跳，它大约节省了两秒；在整个 2014 年 2 月，

cues.en: Greg and Zorin took turns lowering the one lap record until it came down to a fifteen eighty eight held by Greg.
cues.zh: Greg 和 Zorin 轮流刷新单圈纪录，直到降到由 Greg 保持的 1:58.88。

cues.en: Now Greg made his forum posted around 09:30AM
cues.zh: 然后 Greg 在上午 9:30 左右发了论坛帖
时间是 2014 年 2 月 2 日。

cues.en: Mario Kart 64 players from around the world immediately flocked to the thread to congratulate him on his find.
cues.zh: 世界各地的 Mario Kart 64 玩家立刻涌进帖子，祝贺他的发现。

cues.en: Some were amazed by the find, while others were getting ready to track for the world record.
cues.zh: 有些人对这一发现感到惊叹，另一些人则准备追踪世界纪录。

cues.en: However,
cues.zh: 然而，

cues.en: one person's reaction was different from everybody else's.
cues.zh: 有一个人的反应和其他所有人都不同。

cues.en: This guy, weather or not, commonly called Weatherton in the Mario Kart 64 community.
cues.zh: 这位 Weather or Not，在 Mario Kart 64 社区里通常被叫作 Weatherton。

cues.en: Weatherton is a Mario Kart 64 taser,
cues.zh: Weatherton 是一名 Mario Kart 64 的 TAS 玩家，

cues.en: someone who plays the game in an emulator with tools such as slowing everything down, moving frame by frame, and making save states to create a theoretically perfect run.
cues.zh: 也就是在模拟器里玩游戏，借助整体减速、逐帧推进和即时存档等工具，打造理论上完美的通关流程。

cues.en: Weatherton too was excited about this new discovery,
cues.zh: Weatherton也对这个新发现很兴奋，

cues.en: but he immediately had an idea to make it even better.
cues.zh: 但他立刻有了个让它更好的主意。

cues.en: At one in the afternoon on February 2, about three and a half hours after Greg's original post,
cues.zh: 2月2日下午1点，也就是Greg最初发帖约三个半小时后，

cues.en: Weatherton said that he thought a sub 10 lap was possible.
cues.zh: Weatherton说他认为跑进10秒以内的单圈是可能的。

cues.en: His idea was to jump off the wall, fly to the left and land out of bounds on a certain polygon somewhere over here,
cues.zh: 他的想法是从墙上跳下，向左飞，然后落在这一带某个多边形上的出界区域，

cues.en: then get placed back behind the finish line by Lakitu and finish the lap.
cues.zh: 再被Lakitu放回终点线后面，并完成这一圈。

cues.en: So he used his TAS abilities to try to get it to work. The next day, February 3 at 07:30 in the evening, he posted two discoveries.
cues.zh: 于是他用自己的 TAS 能力试着让它成功。第二天，2 月 3 日晚上 7 点 30 分，他发布了两项发现。

cues.en: One, he wasn't able to land his trick.
cues.zh: 第一，他没能成功完成自己的技巧。

cues.en: And two, he had just found a different trick.
cues.zh: 第二，他刚刚发现了一个不同的技巧。

cues.en: Probably the craziest trick in Mario Kart 60 four's history, the weather tango.
cues.zh: 这可能是 Mario Kart 64 历史上最疯狂的技巧，Weather Tango。

cues.en: A six second lap. How is it possible?
cues.zh: 六秒一圈。这怎么可能？

cues.en: The answer lies in how the game handles checkpoints around the track.
cues.zh: 答案在于游戏如何处理赛道周围的检查点。

cues.en: We know from the old tunnel jump that if you get stuck at the top of the hill, the game thinks you're in the tunnel and Lakitu will drop you there. For the weather tanker, you need to hit a very precise place on the wall so that your character will clip into the wall ever so slightly.
cues.zh: 我们从旧的隧道跳跃可知，如果你卡在山顶，游戏会认为你在隧道里，Lakitu 会把你放到那里。对于 Weather Tango，你需要撞到墙上一个非常精确的位置，让角色稍微穿模进墙里。

cues.en: This too makes the game think that you're at the tunnel.
cues.zh: 这也会让游戏以为你在隧道那里。

cues.en: Then, once you drop back down, as long as you're behind the finish line, the game will think you're the end of the lap. So all you need to do is cross it.
cues.zh: 然后，等你落回下方，只要你在终点线后面，游戏就会认为你到了这一圈的末尾。所以你只需要穿过它就行。

cues.en: A six second lap was miles ahead of what anyone dreamed could ever be possible.
cues.zh: 六秒一圈，远远超出了任何人梦想过的极限。

cues.en: But keep in mind, this was a tool assisted speedrun, so it wasn't a world record but rather a proof of concept.
cues.zh: 但请记住，这是工具辅助速通，所以它不是世界纪录，而是一次概念验证。

cues.en: Just because someone could prove that the trick was possible didn't mean a human could pull it off quite yet.
cues.zh: 仅仅因为有人能证明这个技巧可行，并不意味着人类现在就能做到。

cues.en: This trick had a lot of parts to it. You needed it to not get zero framed, bounce high enough, hit the exact right part of the wall, and bounce far enough to the left to land behind the finish line.
cues.zh: 这个技巧包含很多环节。你需要避免被零帧判定，弹得足够高，撞到墙上最精确的位置，并向左弹得足够远，落到终点线后面。

cues.en: Some of the top ranked players around the world began trying to be the first human to hit the trick.
cues.zh: 世界上一些排名顶尖的玩家开始尝试成为第一个完成这个技巧的人类。

cues.en: V. A. J, who is ranked number one in the world for shortcuts,
cues.zh: V. A. J，他在捷径方面排名世界第一，

cues.en: Greg, who is ranked number two, and other top tier players like Miller and Jones.
cues.zh: Greg，排名第二，以及其他顶级选手，比如 Miller 和 Jones。

cues.en: By July 2014, five months after the trick had been discovered, still nobody had been able to land the weather tanko.
cues.zh: 到2014年7月，这个技巧被发现五个月后，仍然没人能成功完成 weather tanko。

cues.en: They came close getting all sorts of jumps near the top of the wall, but it was just too precise for anybody to land.
cues.zh: 他们已经很接近了，在墙顶附近做出各种跳跃，但精度要求太高，没人能成功完成。

cues.en: At least until August 3.
cues.zh: 至少直到8月3日都是如此。

cues.en: That day, someone posted that they had finally been able to pull off the weather tanker.
cues.zh: 那天，有人发帖说他们终于成功做出了 weather tanker。

cues.en: But it wasn't v a j or Greg or any of the really highly ranked shortcut players.
cues.zh: 但并不是 v a j、Greg，也不是那些排名极高的捷径玩家。

cues.en: It was the twenty ninth ranked shortcut player. A guy with the username abney three seventeen.
cues.zh: 而是排名第 29 的捷径玩家，一个用户名是 abney three seventeen 的人。

cues.en: Five eighty nine. This beat the old single app record by ten seconds.
cues.zh: 5.89。这比旧的单圈纪录快了十秒。

cues.en: And as you can imagine, people freaked out.
cues.zh: 你可以想象，大家都炸锅了。

cues.en: This was Abney's first world record, not just for Choco Mountain, but in all of Mario Kart 64 speed running.
cues.zh: 这是 Abney 的第一个世界纪录，不只是 Choco Mountain 的，而是整个《马力欧卡丁车64》速通界的第一个。

cues.en: Nobody was able to take it from him for a few months.
cues.zh: 好几个月都没人能从他手里夺走它。

cues.en: But that November, the competition heated up again.
cues.zh: 但那年11月，竞争又激烈起来了。

cues.en: Patricio managed to take the record from Abney with a five forty four.
cues.zh: Patricio 以5.44的成绩从 Abney 手里夺走了纪录。

cues.en: Abney decided that he didn't feel like losing the Weathertanko record, so he did some attempts on the same day and beat Patricio's time twice,
cues.zh: Abney 不想丢掉 Weathertanko 的纪录，于是当天就试了几次，两次刷新了 Patricio 的成绩，

cues.en: ultimately getting the record down to a four eighty eight.
cues.zh: 最终把纪录压到了4.88。

cues.en: But guess who came back the very next day to break Apne's record?
cues.zh: 但你猜第二天谁又回来打破了 Abney 的纪录？

cues.en: Check this out.
cues.zh: 瞧瞧这个。

cues.en: I beat the task, yo. Second level, man.
cues.zh: 我把任务打过了，哥们。第二关，老兄。

cues.en: I don't have the replay
cues.zh: 我没录像

cues.en: because I pressed start,
cues.zh: 因为我按了开始，

cues.en: and it happened in ten minutes. Just ten minutes, man. Ten minutes after my five seventeen on the first lap. I was like, you know what? Let's try second lap. And then I hit it motherfucker.
cues.zh: 然后十分钟就搞定了。就十分钟，哥们。就在我第一圈跑出5分17秒后的十分钟。我心想，你知道吗？试试第二圈。然后我就成了，妈的。

cues.en: I went over to finish. I just pressed pressed the shroom. I jumped and then I hit it. I was like, woah.
cues.zh: 我过去终点。我就按了按蘑菇。我跳了一下，然后就中了。我当时想，哇。

cues.en: Fuck it out. Ebony, I got you, man. TJ's back, y'all.
cues.zh: 管他呢。Ebony，我挺你，哥们。TJ回来了，各位。

cues.en: Check this out, y'all.
cues.zh: 各位，看这个。

cues.en: VHA would hold on to this record of 3.26
cues.zh: VHA 会守住 3.26 这个纪录

cues.en: for a few months, but Abney would end up tying and eventually beating his time in the early months of 2015.
cues.zh: 保持几个月，但 Abney 最终追平，并在 2015 年初打破了他的用时。

cues.en: Abney would continue lowering the one lap record closer and closer to three seconds flat over the next few years.
cues.zh: 接下来几年，Abney 会继续压低单圈纪录，越来越接近整三秒。

cues.en: The three lap record, however, was a little different.
cues.zh: 不过，三圈纪录就有点不一样了。

cues.en: It was a story that had not yet been written.
cues.zh: 那是一段尚未被写下的故事。

cues.en: Before the weather tanker was discovered, you would have to drive around the track and get as many whole jumps or tunnel jumps as possible to get a world record.
cues.zh: 在 weather tanker 被发现之前，你得绕着赛道开，尽可能多完成完整跳跃或隧道跳跃，才能拿到世界纪录。

cues.en: The weather tank will completely change the playing field.
cues.zh: Weather Tank 会彻底改变比赛局面。

cues.en: You're given three mushrooms to work with in time trials, so you could potentially hit three weather tankos,
cues.zh: 在计时赛里你会拿到三个蘑菇可用，所以理论上可以打出三个 Weather Tanko，

cues.en: one on each lap and be done with the whole race super quickly in under twenty seconds possibly.
cues.zh: 每圈一个，整场比赛可能不到二十秒就飞快结束。

cues.en: So by late twenty fourteen, the question had to be asked, how many weather tankos could somebody hit in a single race?
cues.zh: 所以到 2014 年底，问题就来了：单场比赛中一个人能打出多少个 Weather Tanko？

cues.en: For a while, the answer was just one. Abney got a couple of three lap records that were under a minute shortly after he pulled off the first weather tanko in November 2014.
cues.zh: 有一段时间，答案只是一个。Abney 在 2014 年 11 月首次成功打出 Weather Tanko 后不久，就拿下了几个三圈用时不到一分钟的纪录。

cues.en: These were both done by executing one weather tank with the start and then trying to land as many hill jumps as possible after.
cues.zh: 这两项都是靠起跑时执行一次 weather tank，然后尽可能多地让 hill jumps 成功落地做到的。

cues.en: Abney once again made history.
cues.zh: Abney 再次创造了历史。

cues.en: He became the first person to pull off two weather in the same run.
cues.zh: 他成为第一个在同一次跑图中成功完成两次 weather 的人。

cues.en: This pushed the three lap record down to 44
cues.zh: 这将三圈纪录缩短到 44 秒，

cues.en: and that's where it stood for more than a year.
cues.zh: 而这个纪录保持了一年多。

cues.en: Was hitting three out of three weather tank was possible?
cues.zh: 三次 weather tank 全部成功，真的可能吗？

cues.en: I mean, sure theoretically it was. But Abney's odds in a weather tank on any given attempt were only about one in 40.
cues.zh: 我是说，理论上当然可能。但 Abney 在任何一次尝试中成功完成 weather tank 的概率只有大约四十分之一。

cues.en: He needed to hit three of these in a row. So that put the odds at about one in sixty four thousand that an attempt would be able to hit three weather tankos.
cues.zh: 他需要连续命中三个。所以一次尝试能连续命中三个 weather tanko 的概率大约是六万四千分之一。

cues.en: In the summer of twenty seventeen,
Abney made a decision.
cues.zh: Abney 做了一个决定。

cues.en: He was going to try to get a three out of three weather tanko run and nothing was gonna stop him. He was going to start, hit a weather tanko, immediately set up and hit another one, and then immediately set up and hit a third one.
cues.zh: 他要尝试打出三发三中的 weather tanko 连击，谁也拦不住他。他打算先起手，命中一个 weather tanko，立刻调整位置再命中一个，然后马上调整位置命中第三个。

cues.en: Back to back to back.
cues.zh: 连续三次。

cues.en: And I know what a lot of you are probably thinking right now. Why was Abney bothering to do this? He was literally booting up his stream just drive into a wall over and over again for a few hours.
cues.zh: 我知道你们很多人现在大概在想什么。Abney 为什么要费劲干这事？他开直播， literally 就是为了连续几个小时一遍又一遍地往墙上撞。

cues.en: You'd think that it would be incredibly boring to watch him do these attempt sessions, but that wasn't at all the case.
cues.zh: 你可能会觉得，看他这样一遍遍尝试会无聊透顶，但事实完全不是这样。

cues.en: He streamed all of his attempts on Twitch and the chat there was filled with hundreds of people anxiously awaiting the one run that would be the one.
cues.zh: 他把所有尝试都放在 Twitch 上直播，聊天室里挤满了数百人，焦急地等着那一把——就是成功的那一把。

cues.en: They watched him as his attempt counter climbed higher and higher.
cues.zh: 他们看着他，尝试次数计数器越爬越高。

cues.en: First past 10,000 attempts and then past 20,000.
cues.zh: 先是超过 10,000 次尝试，接着又超过 20,000 次。

cues.en: Most people wouldn't have had the patience to do these attempts nearly every day for weeks.
cues.zh: 大多数人不会有耐心连续数周几乎每天都这样尝试。

cues.en: But Abney knew Chalka Mountain was at its breaking point.
cues.zh: 但 Abney 知道，Chalka Mountain 已经濒临被攻破。

cues.en: Not even a job dude.
cues.zh: 这甚至都不算个工作，兄弟。

cues.en: He had almost killed the most infamous track in the game.
cues.zh: 他几乎已经攻克了游戏里最臭名昭著的赛道。

cues.en: All he needed was one attempt.
cues.zh: 他只需要一次尝试。

cues.en: God, dude. We got two out three that... Like,
cues.zh: 天哪，兄弟。我们三次里成了两次，那个……就像，

cues.en: I already hit the two out. One perfect attempt that would grant him the title of one of the most legendary speedrun world records ever.
cues.zh: 我已经打出了那两次中的一次。一次完美尝试，就能让他拿下史上最传奇的速通世界纪录之一的头衔。

cues.en: Yes. Let's go. Let's go.
cues.zh: 好。走起。走起。

cues.en: That's it.
cues.zh: 就是这样。

cues.en: Yes.
cues.zh: 对。

cues.en: Let's go.
cues.zh: 走起。

cues.en: Twenty six thousand four hundred sixty one attempts later, Abney had accomplished what was thought to be impossible.
cues.zh: 在两万六千四百六十一次尝试之后，Abney 完成了被认为不可能的事。

cues.en: Chaco Mountain had been all but destroyed.
cues.zh: Chaco Mountain 几乎被彻底摧毁了。

cues.en: All the years of figuring out shortcut after shortcut,
cues.zh: 多年来，他一个接一个地找出捷径，

cues.en: taking world record after world record, had finally culminated in a three out of three weather tango.
cues.zh: 打破一个又一个世界纪录，最终促成了 3/3 的天气探戈。

cues.en: As of the time I'm making this video, nobody's replicated this feat and I can't imagine what somebody would have to go to to lower the three lap record anymore.
cues.zh: 截至我做这个视频时，还没有人复现这一壮举，我也无法想象还要做到什么地步，才能再刷新三圈纪录。

cues.en: The one lap record on the other hand was recently taken below three seconds by a guy named Frankie. Yes.
cues.zh: 另一方面，单圈纪录最近被一个叫 Frankie 的人跑进了三秒以内。没错。

cues.en: Abney's tied this time a couple of days later and has been trying to push it lower ever since.
cues.zh: Abney 几天后追平了这个成绩，此后一直在尝试把它压得更低。

cues.en: In total, 13 people have been able to pull off a weather taco with 11 of them doing it in the time trials mode. The fastest time coming from the aforementioned world record and the slowest time coming from Theodore fifth nine.
cues.zh: 总共有 13 人成功完成了 weather taco，其中 11 人是在计时赛模式中做到的。最快成绩来自前面提到的世界纪录，最慢成绩来自 Theodore fifth nine。

cues.en: Another couple of quick things I have to mention. This game was released in Japan before it was released anywhere else in the world, so Japanese players had the records before anybody else did and it's possible they may have had faster times than the rest of the world for a while.
cues.zh: 还有几件小事必须提一下。这款游戏在日本首发，早于世界其他地方，所以日本玩家比其他任何人都更早拿到记录，有一段时间他们的成绩可能比世界其他地区更快。

cues.en: However, it's not really documented anywhere online, so it's impossible to add them into the timeline.
cues.zh: 不过，网上并没有相关记载，所以无法把这些记录加进时间线。

cues.en: And of course, there's a whole different side to Chaco Mountain, the non shortcut side, which is currently dominated by Matthias Rustemeyer.
cues.zh: 当然，Chaco Mountain 还有完全不同的一面，也就是不走捷径的那一面，目前由 Matthias Rustemeyer 主导。

cues.en: No wall jumps, hill jumps, or weather tinkles allowed, just perfect driving around the course.
cues.zh: 不允许跳墙、跳坡，也不允许搞 weather tinkles，只要完美地绕赛道驾驶。

cues.en: Matthias is definitely one of the best people to ever play Mario Kart 64,
cues.zh: Matthias 绝对是有史以来玩 Mario Kart 64 最厉害的人之一，

cues.en: maybe the best ever.
cues.zh: 也许还是史上最强。

cues.en: The next time you're playing Mario Kart 64, try playing Chaka Mountain.
cues.zh: 下次玩 Mario Kart 64 时，试试 Chaka Mountain。

cues.en: See if you could hop over any walls or skip over any parts of the track. Maybe you'll be the next David Wan and discover new shortcuts or the next Abony and you're gonna defy the odds to hit three weather tacos in a row again.
cues.zh: 看看你能不能跳过墙，或者跳过赛道的某些部分。也许你会成为下一个 David Wan，发现新捷径；或者成为下一个 Abony，再次逆天连续命中三个 weather tacos。

cues.en: Whatever it may be, you can be sure that you've done it on the most infamous track in the game. Thanks for watching.
cues.zh: 不管是什么，你都可以确定，你是在这个游戏最臭名昭著的赛道上完成的。感谢观看。

cues.en: If you like watching speedruns, be sure to follow me on my Twitch channel, twitch.tv/summoningsalt.
cues.zh: 如果你喜欢看速通，记得关注我的 Twitch 频道：twitch.tv/summoningsalt。

cues.en: Thanks.
cues.zh: 谢谢。
